Sicilian Pizza Dough for 2 Balls

Sicilian Pizza Dough for 2 balls uses 70% water, no starter, 2.2% salt, and 0.5% yeast. Two balls at 450 g each come to 900 g. Cut the dough in half and weigh both pieces. Press the dough into a well-oiled square pan and proof it until it looks jiggly before you top it.
